title: role.list result, contract version 1
description: The result of role.list (PRD 5.10): a page of roles, each with its handle, classification ceiling, permissions and version. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Core\Access\Domain\Dto\RoleList, and the generated codec writes its canonical JSON: keys sorted, no whitespace.

next.description: The id to read the next page after, or null when this page is the last.

ceiling.description: The highest classification the role lets its holders read (PRD 12.2).

handle.description: The role's handle: a lowercase letter, then at most 62 lowercase letters, digits and underscores.

permissions.description: The names of the commands and queries the role may run, sorted.

items.description: A command or query name, such as entry.create.
